name: accept-task-suggestion
businessNeed: Let a person explicitly turn one reviewed AI plan suggestion into a governed task.

workItems.description: Expose suggestion acceptance through its own governed feature contract.
workItems.acceptanceCriterion: AI Planning contributes suggestion data without importing or calling Task Management feature code.

workItems.description: Compose the acceptance action through a typed suggestion action slot.
workItems.acceptanceCriterion: The accepting contribution is independently discovered and invalidates the task collection after success.
